notebooks.title: Reproduce the main chart and signal flags (Python)
notebooks.description: Loads a disease's data, redraws a country chart with incomplete periods marked, recomputes the signal flags and checks them against the published ones, and loads a specific snapshot.

notebooks.title: Example gallery: using the revision history (Python)
notebooks.description: Three short analyses: how often values are revised by source, how large and how late revisions are, and one series at two snapshots.

notebooks.title: Run a sandbox model specification and a sweep (Python)
notebooks.description: Illustrative simulation, not a forecast. Loads a model spec exported from the sandbox, runs it with scipy, and sweeps one parameter.

notebooks.title: Reproduce the main chart (R, tidyverse)
notebooks.description: Loads the data with arrow and dplyr, redraws a country chart, and loads a specific snapshot. The in-browser console runs a base-R starter script.

notebooks.title: Run a sandbox model with deSolve (R)
notebooks.description: Illustrative simulation, not a forecast. Runs the SEIR teaching model with deSolve and sweeps one parameter.
